name: uml_review_context_build
description: Build a UML review context bundle with scope summaries, entity context cards, and tooltip payloads.

inputs.output_dir: Optional output directory. Defaults to Docs/uml/review_context.
inputs.include_tests: Whether test files should be included in the scan. Defaults to false.
inputs.neighbor_depth: How far module neighborhoods should be expanded for context. Defaults to 1.
inputs.max_neighbors: Maximum neighbor modules retained per module. Defaults to 10.

outputs.context_json: JSON bundle with directory, module, and symbol context.
outputs.tooltips_json: Tooltip payload map for explorer links and context chips.
outputs.summary_md: Markdown summary of the generated review context.
